items.title: 1.6 Periodic tarteeb aur electronic configuration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.6, printed pages 6-7.

blocks.text: Periodic table mein anasir ki tarteeb un ki tabee khusoosiyat, jaise tabee halat aur atomic radius, aur un ki electronic banawat aur kimiyai reactivity ke bare mein qeemti samajh deti hai.

items: Period number principal quantum number n hai, yani nucleus ke gird electron shells ki tadaad. Teesre period ka unsur X teen shells rakhta hai, aur us ke valence electrons teesre shell mein hain. Woh subshell jis mein yeh hain unsur ke block (azimuthal quantum number) par munhasir hai: agar period 3 ka X s block mein hai to us ke valence electrons 3s subshell mein hain.

Group number valence electrons ki tadaad batata hai. Period 3 aur group 2 ka unsur apne bairooni shell mein do valence electrons rakhta hai, to period 3, group 2 (s block) ka unsur 3s subshell mein do electrons rakhta hai aur magnesium (Mg) hona chahiye.

blocks.text: Ek aur misal period aur group number ko configuration aur jagah se jorti hai. Agar X group 13 aur period 3 mein hai to us ke teen valence electrons (group 13) teesre shell (period 3) mein hain, to configuration 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p1 hai, jis mein pehla, doosra aur teesra shell isi tarteeb se bharte hain. Is liye periodic tarteeb samajhna unsur ki electronic configuration samjhata hai, jo us ki kimiyai khusoosiyat aur rawaiya samajhne ke liye lazmi hai.

blocks.caption: Configuration se jagah parhna

Period 3: teen shells; valence electrons shell 3 mein

blocks.prompt: Ek unsur period 2 aur group 14 mein hai. Us ki electronic configuration likhein, block batayein aur use pehchanein. Phir period 4, group 17 ka unsur batayein.
blocks.explanation: Period 2 ka matlab do shells aur group 14 ka matlab chaar valence electrons, to configuration 1s2 2s2 2p2 hai: p block, carbon. Period 4, group 17 chauthe period ka halogen hai, bromine.

items: Period number = shells ki tadaad (n); block = valence electrons ka subshell; group number = valence electrons ki tadaad.
Period 3, group 2, s block: 3s2, magnesium. Period 3, group 13: 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p1.
